name: session-strip
description: Publishes each Claude Code session's synopsis (project, task, tools running) and id for an on-screen strip

useHaiku.title: Summarize the task with Haiku
useHaiku.description: One tiny Haiku call (~$0.0006) writes the task line when you send the first prompt, then rewrites it every few minutes while the session works. Off: the task is the first prompt, truncated.

summarizeEveryMinutes.title: Re-summarize every N minutes
summarizeEveryMinutes.description: While the session works, the task line is rewritten at most this often, when a tool call or a turn finishes. An idle session is never re-summarized.
